# Cloudscape Reference

Real Cloudscape components rendered with the RiskSmart theme — what's currently
shipped in the live web app. Use these as visual reference when prototyping
features alongside atomic-ui (the migration target).

All stories import from `@risk-smart/themed-cloudscape-components` (private,
needs `read:packages` PAT for `@risk-smart` scope) and tag with
`['cloudscape-real']`.

## Generated by

`scripts/generate-cloudscape-stories.mjs` — run again to regenerate after a
package version bump.

## Components (65 stories)

### Display
- **Alert** — surface a status message above page content (info / success / warning / error)
- **Badge** — small label for a count or category, inline with text
- **Box** — flexible spacing/typography primitive (h1, p, code, etc.)
- **Header** — page or section title with optional description, counter, and actions
- **Icon** — render a Cloudscape icon by name (settings, search, status-warning…)
- **Link** — text link with optional external indicator, primary/info variants
- **Spinner** — loading indicator (normal / big / large)
- **StatusIndicator** — inline status pill with eight states (success, error, in-progress…)
- **TextContent** — rich-text wrapper with Cloudscape-correct heading and list styling

### Layout
- **ColumnLayout** — fixed 1–4 column grid with shared spacing
- **Container** — bordered surface with optional header and footer
- **ContentLayout** — page-level wrapper that frames Header + body content
- **ExpandableSection** — collapsible panel (default / footer / container variants)
- **Form** — wraps form fields with action buttons in the footer
- **FormField** — labelled wrapper around any input with description / constraint / error text
- **Grid** — explicit 12-column grid via `gridDefinition`
- **KeyValuePairs** — labelled value tuples laid out in 1–4 columns
- **ProgressBar** — horizontal progress with status, label, additional info
- **SpaceBetween** — vertical or horizontal stack with consistent gap

### Inputs
- **Autosuggest** — single-select with text input + filtered suggestions
- **Calendar** — standalone date picker without input field
- **Checkbox** — single boolean (with `indeterminate`)
- **DateInput** — keyboard-only YYYY/MM/DD input
- **DatePicker** — DateInput + popover Calendar
- **DateRangePicker** — relative or absolute range picker
- **Input** — text / search / email / number / password
- **Multiselect** — multi-select dropdown with token chips
- **PromptInput** — chat-style input with action button (used for AI prompts)
- **RadioGroup** — single-select from a vertical list
- **SegmentedControl** — small inline tab-bar (Day / Week / Month etc.)
- **Select** — single-select dropdown
- **Slider** — numeric slider with min/max
- **Textarea** — multi-line text input
- **Tiles** — large radio-card selector with description text
- **TimeInput** — hh:mm or hh:mm:ss
- **Toggle** — boolean switch
- **ToggleButton** — pressable button with on/off icon

### Collections
- **AttributeEditor** — repeating key/value rows with add/remove
- **BreadcrumbGroup** — hierarchical navigation trail
- **ButtonDropdown** — single button with a menu of items
- **ButtonGroup** — multiple buttons (icon variant) grouped together
- **Cards** — collection of cards with selection / empty / loading states
- **Pagination** — page selector (currentPageIndex + pagesCount)
- **SideNavigation** — left-rail nav with sections, links, and dividers
- **Steps** — vertical step list with status icons (success / loading / in-progress / pending)
- **Table** — full-featured data grid with selection / empty / loading
- **TagEditor** — key/value tags with AWS-style validation
- **Tabs** — horizontal tabs (default / container variants)
- **TokenGroup** — dismissible token list (filter chips, applied tags)
- **Wizard** — multi-step form with previous / next / submit

### Overlays
- **CopyToClipboard** — small button + label that copies text
- **Drawer** — side panel (renders inside AppLayout in production)
- **Flashbar** — stack of toast-style alerts
- **Modal** — standard overlay with header / body / footer
- **Popover** — click or hover popover anchored to a trigger

### Files
- **FileDropzone** — drag-and-drop zone for files
- **FileInput** — native file picker with custom button
- **FileTokenGroup** — list of attached files as dismissible tokens
- **FileUpload** — full upload UI: dropzone + tokens + i18n strings

### Charts
- **AreaChart** — filled time-series
- **BarChart** — vertical or stacked bars
- **LineChart** — time-series line chart
- **MixedLineBarChart** — combine bars and lines on one axis
- **PieChart** — donut / pie with auto-filter

## Skipped components (16)

See `SKIP.md` for the full list and reason. Most need provider context (annotation,
i18n, AppLayout) or heavy setup (S3, Ace editor) that doesn't fit a reference story.

## Use in prototypes

Drop a Cloudscape component into a `src/prototypes/` story alongside atomic-ui
components — the alias `@risksmart-app/atomic-ui` resolves to the dev repo:

```tsx
import Button from '@risk-smart/themed-cloudscape-components/button';
import { Card } from '@risksmart-app/atomic-ui';
```

Both are themed to RiskSmart's branding so they sit comfortably side by side
when you're stitching features that span the migration.
